title: A square function
description:
Write functions that follow the System V calling convention.

```
square(12) = 144
cube(-3) = -27
sum3(1, 2, 3) = 6
```

starter.main.asm:
global  _start

        section .text
square:
        mov     rax, rdi
        ret

_start:
        mov     edi, 12
        call    square
        mov     rdi, rax
        call    print_int
        call    print_newline

        mov     eax, 60
        xor     edi, edi
        syscall

hints: `imul rax, rdi` after `mov rax, rdi` squares (lesson 5.01).
`cube` must keep its argument across `call square`: push it, or keep it in a callee-saved register that `cube` saves itself.
requirements: `square` and `cube` take `rdi` and return in `rax`; `cube` calls `square`.
Each function ends with `ret` and changes only registers it is allowed to.
